research_dossier.topic: The Mary Celeste Abandoned at Sea
research_dossier.core_conflict: A fully seaworthy ship with six months of provisions was abruptly abandoned without distress signals.

beats.text: In 1872, an intact ship was found sailing alone across the Atlantic.
British sailors boarded the Mary Celeste expecting to find a pirate raid.
Instead, they found six months of fresh food untouched in the galley.
All seventeen hundred barrels of industrial alcohol sat safely locked in the hold.
The crew's personal belongings and dry clothing were left completely undisturbed.
Yet the captain, his family, and seven veteran sailors had vanished without a trace.
Naval courts investigated for months but found zero evidence of foul play or mutiny.
Decades later, maritime archives still preserve the intact ship that sailed alone.
